_doc: The Lamp Engine's surfaces (docs/kb/art/creatures/act2/lamp_engine.md). Slots are the glTF material names; write_materials.py writes assets/creatures/lamp_engine/materials/<slot>.tres on game/shaders/creature/creature.gdshader. frame is the brass (bronze_patina, wet below the waterline, lacquer_black joints, a sooty inside to the petals and the hood, by vertex colour and wetness; no emission). hub is the gimbal hubs, the weak points: spawn_wound, its slow weak-point pulse. glass is the twelve salt-glass chimneys lit from inside by their bound light (glimmer_bound, steady, never pulsing: color_script.md rule 2), sea_glow drips on them. core is the cracked salt-glass globe holding the brightest bound light (glimmer_bound, steady). Colours are palette.json swatches.
